name: Devourer of Souls
summary: Gan'rul Bloodeye sends an aspiring Horde warlock to begin the path to summoning and commanding a succubus. In Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, the warlock seeks Cazul's counsel on luring and binding the demon.

sections.title: A Step Into Seductive Shadows
sections.body: Horde warlocks who master lesser demons such as imps and voidwalkers may seek a succubus next. Gan'rul Bloodeye oversees the dark arts beneath Orgrimmar and judges when a warlock is ready to call one from the Twisting Nether. A succubus can turn the frail against themselves, so binding one takes subtlety as well as strength.

sections.title: The Lore of Cazul
sections.body: A succubus preys on mortal desire, so raw incantations cannot call one alone. The summoner must lure it with an object filled with pure love and devotion. Gan'rul is unwilling or unable to provide such a relic himself, so he sends the warlock across the Cleft of Shadow to Cazul. The ancient warlock knows the arcane and demonic rites needed for the next part of the ritual.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: This begins an aspiring Horde warlock's path to learning how to summon and command a succubus. It connects you with mentors in the Cleft of Shadow, who teach you the demon's nature and how to lure one from the Twisting Nether.
Cazul is in the Cleft of Shadow, a cavern beneath Orgrimmar where rogue and warlock trainers practice away from the Warchief's scrutiny.

faq.q: Why does a warlock need an object of love to summon a succubus?
faq.answer: Succubi feed on mortal emotion, devotion, and weak will. To draw one from the Twisting Nether, a summoner offers a potent token of genuine devotion and affection as bait, then overpowers and binds the demon.
Gan'rul Bloodeye is a senior Horde warlock trainer in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. He guides developing practitioners through the bindings of increasingly powerful demonic servants.

faq.q: What level is required to begin this quest?
faq.answer: A warlock must reach level twenty before Gan'rul judges their magical prowess and mental fortitude sufficient. The ritual means bargaining with a succubus and surviving the encounter.

faq.q: What follows after speaking with Cazul?
aliases: next quest after devourer of souls
faq.answer: Speaking with Cazul leads to Blind Cazul. There, you seek Zankaja in Orgrimmar, whose mate Dogran has not returned from duty at the Crossroads. The search for a suitable token of love begins with her.

angles.text: As a warlock, you take a step toward commanding demons of mental dominance and seduction. The rite calls for psychological resolve as well as raw fel power.

As a member of the Horde, you see warlocks conduct dangerous rites in the Cleft of Shadow's damp, secluded crevices. Thrall's shamans and warriors practice in public, while warlocks work out of sight.
